claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

One first-family quark SU(3)L triplet with N=2/3, two anti-triplets with N=-1/3, three lepton triplets N=0 containing charged antileptons; no RH neutrinos. RH quarks are SU(3)L singlets, usual u/d N=2/3,-1/3, exotic J1=5/3 and two J=-4/3. Explicit colour counted for anomalies. Scalars eta,rho,chi are complex SU(3)L triplets of N=0,+1,-1. Normalize whole spectrum by q=3N; conjugate every RH colour and charge.
Optional sigma and omega have exactly eta quantum numbers; add two complex triplets (1,3,0), not a new arbitrary charge family.
